entries.name: execution-report
entries.description: Rebuild an offline UI exploration or formal execution report from the original stage.
inputs: Midscene observations or verified pytest V5 session

entries.name: plan
entries.description: Prepare a UI automation plan with source-grounded assertions and a validated main Packet.
inputs: Source case or business objective and source material
requires: Identifiable scope, current task identity and observable business oracle
outputs: Plan and Packet 3.0 or clarification items

entries.name: evidence
entries.description: 整理 UI 测试步骤、截图及被动监听证据
requires: 运行、用例、尝试及步骤身份
outputs: 带来源与缺项的步骤证据索引

entries.name: review
entries.description: 分析本次 UI 测试为何失败，给出失败归因、原件依据及处理范围。普通 Python 代码评审使用代码评审入口。
inputs: 本次 UI 执行原件或步骤证据索引
outputs: 失败原因、依据及待核实项

entries.name: assets
entries.description: 查明 UI 项目当前适用的资产版本、选择理由、依赖与启停记录。
inputs: 项目资产声明、能力、用例和授权条件
outputs: 生效版本、限定范围与待核对发现

entries.name: experience
entries.description: 查阅 UI 测试策略的来源及适用范围，或登记已有有效步骤的候选经验。
inputs: 查询范围或已有步骤原件
requires: 项目范围和可追溯来源
outputs: 带来源的经验查询或候选记录
